source.value: Rippers Unmasked — The Low Fantasy Atlas (Create Phantasm: Numen — Illusionist Heroic Skill)

summary.value: You can now have up to 4 active Phantasms, but one of them must necessarily be Numen.

system.description: You can now have up to 4 active Phantasms, but one of them must necessarily be Numen. ... When creating a Numen Phantasm, choose one essence, which dictates Numen's Damage Type: Ravana (Physical), Asura (Light), Diablos (Dark). The target hit by Numen suffers (HR + 14) damage. This damage increases to 18 if you are level 20 or higher, or to 20 if you are level 40 or higher. Damage dealt by Numen ignores Resistances and Immunities. The range of the attack is determined by your current weapon.
